findings.title: IDOR - Hidden Order Receipt Disclosure
findings.description: By fuzzing order IDs in the /order/{id}/archive endpoint, a hidden order (300198) was discovered. Archiving this order made it appear in the /orders_archive page, and its receipt contained the flag. This demonstrates an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability where order IDs can be enumerated and their contents accessed.

reproduction.command:
1. Login as test:test
2. Archive order IDs in range 300001-300999 via GET /order/{id}/archive
3. Check /orders_archive for new order 300198
4. GET /order/300198/receipt reveals the flag
